slots.title: October CPI MoM 0.4% vs 0.3% est.
slots.body:
October inflation (prices consumers pay, month over month): **0.4%** actual vs **0.3%** estimate.

Prior month: **0.6%**.

Headline CPI index: **337.51** vs **337.02** est. (prior **336.94**).

Seasonally adjusted CPI level: **337.48** vs **337** est.

Core prices excluding food and energy rose **0.3%** MoM — in line with the prior month and above the **0.2%** forecast.

The print landed at 8:30 a.m.
ET on Nov. 10.

slots.title: Fed speakers after firm core CPI
slots.body:
October core inflation (excluding food and energy) came in **0.3%** MoM vs a **0.2%** estimate.

Fed coverage after the data: officials are weighing whether rate increases need to come **bigger or faster**, with a third straight month of firm underlying inflation in the story.

Philadelphia Fed President Anna Paulson — a voter on the rate-setting committee — said more tightening is ahead but she would prefer to **tighten gradually** when conditions allow.

October CPI index: **337.51** (est. **337.02**).

The next Fed meeting is in December.

slots.title: US close — Nov. 10, 2026
slots.body:
The S&P 500 ended at 7,521.26, down 28.68 points (−0.4%).
The session ranged 7,470.43 to 7,543.92.

Fed-facing headlines in the feed pointed to officials discussing a quicker or larger path of rate increases after firm underlying inflation.
